write_guards.message: do not serve web/ via filepath.Join("..", …) — use filepath.Join("web", file) from module root
register static handler as mux.HandleFunc("/static/", …) not "/static" — required for style.css and traversal tests
in the /static/ handler (first lines of the HandleFunc callback) reject ".." on r.URL.RequestURI() or RawPath — ServeMux redirects before nested helpers run

traversal_redirect.title: Handler test: path traversal (got 307, want 404)
traversal_redirect.cause: **Cause:** `net/http.ServeMux` redirects (`307`) **before** your `{{static_pattern}}` handler runs; checks only inside nested helpers or on trimmed `r.URL.Path` are too late.
fixes: Register static routes as **`mux.HandleFunc({{static_pattern}}, …)`** (trailing slash when architecture uses `/static/{file}`).
At the **first line** of the **`{{static_pattern}}` handler** (not only in a nested helper), reject traversal on the raw request:
Serve files from **`filepath.Join("{{web_disk_dir}}", name)`** with `name` from `strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, {{static_prefix}})` — do **not** use `../../web`.
Do **not** switch to `HandleFunc("/static", …)` without a trailing slash to avoid redirects — that breaks normal static asset GETs.
End native **EDIT:** blocks with a line containing only **`>>>>>>> REPLACE`** (never `---END EDIT---`).

test_cwd.title: Handler test 404 (go test working directory)
test_cwd.cause: **Cause:** `go test ./internal/...` runs with cwd = the **package directory**, but handlers use relative paths like `{{web_disk_dir}}/index.html` from the **module root**.
fixes_handlers_bead: **While handlers.go is active:** prefer fixing GET / via **`serveWebFile(w, r, "index.html")`** in the `/` handler (helper that finds `{{web_disk_dir}}/`), not more `filepath.Join("{{web_disk_dir}}", …)` on `ServeFile` alone.
**Alternatively (handlers_test.go bead):** open the test bead, then at Test start:
test_cwd.footer: Do **not** use `../../web` in handlers.go. **Verify:** `cd {{layout_root}} && go test -count=1 ./internal/api/...` from mayor/rig.

root_404_serve_helper.title: Handler test 404 on GET / (fix on **this** handlers.go bead)
root_404_serve_helper.cause: **Cause:** `http.ServeFile(w, r, filepath.Join("{{web_disk_dir}}", "index.html"))` resolves `{{web_disk_dir}}/` from the **test package cwd**, not the module root.
fixes: In the `/` handler call your **`serveWebFile(w, r, "index.html")`** helper (walks up to `{{web_disk_dir}}/`).
Put `RequestURI`/`RawPath` `..` checks on the **first line** of the `{{static_pattern}}` `HandleFunc` callback.

common: Production serves files from **`{{web_disk_dir}}/`** on disk — do **not** use temp dirs with `index.html` at module root unless architecture says so.
Use a fixed **webRoot** (e.g. discovered via `go.mod` or `os.Getwd` walk-up to `{{web_disk_dir}}/`).
handler_bead: **Static route:** `mux.HandleFunc({{static_pattern}}, …)`; first line: reject `..` on `r.URL.RequestURI()` / `RawPath`; then serve from `filepath.Join("{{web_disk_dir}}", …)`.
test_bead: **Handler tests:** `go test` cwd is the **package dir** — `os.Chdir({{chdir_expr}})` at Test start so `{{web_disk_dir}}/index.html` paths work.
Table cases from architecture: `GET /`, static assets, traversal probe `{{traversal_probe_path}}` → **404** (not **307**).
